external_sampling.activity_proxy: profile pushed_at within 90 days of 2026-11-09T00:00:00Z; metadata only, not a model feature
external_sampling.selection_rule: 每层可用候选按固定哈希排序，尽量各取两名近期/非近期；某组不足时以同层剩余候选补足，不按模型表现替换。
external_sampling.metadata_failures: 保留失败记录；只在冻结前按上述固定规则从同层剩余候选补齐。

events.commits: committer timestamp, fallback author timestamp, on default branch SHA visible at collection
events.pull_requests: all states, created_at; creation-order pages until before window or terminal page

feature_sets.A: log1p commit total and log1p all-PR-created total
feature_sets.C: shape features: commit and PR active-week fractions, commit longest zero-run fraction, log1p weekly CV with mean+1 smoothing, log1p clipped 12-week/previous-40-week smoothed mean ratio, log1p smoothed PR/commit ratio

training.fit: historical train IDs only; fit scaling and KMeans together
training.selection: historical validation IDs only; prefer C then B among qualifying candidates, select highest validation silhouette; if none qualify freeze the best stability candidate as research-only
training.baseline: A size-only KMeans, and descriptive activity tertiles
training.comparison: Ward on train as diagnostic only; never used for online inference
training.within_size_bins: at least two of three train-derived size tertiles have at least two clusters each with at least three members

external.ood_rule: training-derived per-cluster 99th percentile standardized distance and feature ranges; reject rather than force assignment
external.nontrivial_gain: within at least two activity tertiles, at least two clusters have >=3 repositories, and shape-space silhouette exceeds size-only baseline by >=0.05
external.evaluation_reuse: only one formal evaluation per frozen model and holdout; failed results remain frozen
external.human_review: two actual independent humans review at least 40 eligible repositories, neutral descriptions and disagreements; project owner approval required

prohibitions: 未通过人工审查、独立评估与负责人批准不得生产加载
维护行为簇不是质量分数，不进入选型总分
不把当前分支快照伪称过去时点的默认分支成员关系
